title: Prop 15.270 G+≻0 on W++0 via k=3 Singer Gram

p5_k3_misses.note: Jacquet (every irrep has a U-invariant) does not force the k=3 locked-triple space F to meet every irrep of 𝒲₊₊⁰.

small_dft.theorem: For 7≤p≤31 the locked-triple Singer circulant has no vanishing DFT coefficient (direct computation of the Gram on the good-line Singer cycle).  Combined with Gershgorin for p≥37 this gives PD of every G^{(μ)} for all primes p≥7.
